sinopsis.es: Un extraño circo, compuesto básicamente por una ballena en descomposición, llega a un pequeño pueblo húngaro. La película construye una metáfora de cómo un líder puede aprovecharse del miedo y la paranoia de una colectividad hasta desatar la violencia y el caos.
sinopsis.en: With the arrival of a strange circus — consisting mainly of a decomposing whale — in a small Hungarian village, the film constructs its visual and narrative metaphor about how a leader can exploit the fear and paranoia of a community to create violence and chaos. At the dawn of the new century, Béla Tarr and Ágnes Hranitzky use their particular aesthetic to speak of the nightmares of Hungarian (and perhaps global) history, which the following years would prove were not far from resurfacing. (E.V.)
